hypotheses.note: brief-supplied and family-name WHYs are HYPOTHESES; four consecutive rounds inverted their briefs

CAND_unresolved_magnitude.H-A_instrument_window: the observed magnitude IS a legal gen3 roll (floor(base*r/100), r in 85..100) of the engine's OWN damage base, but the matcher's exact-membership path was unavailable at that boundary (calculate_damage refused, e.g. switch choices -> strict:no_damage_rolls) and the fallback proportional window [0.92*eng-1, 1.09*eng+1] around the engine's representative roll is TIGHTER than true legality near the min roll for small magnitudes; lane = instrument, clearance signature = magnitude (clears in place under a legality-aware readout)
CAND_unresolved_magnitude.H-B_engine_base: the engine's damage base differs from Showdown's realized base by >= 1 point at these boundaries (a pipeline-step or modifier gap); observed lies OUTSIDE the engine's own legal roll set; lane = engine (damage patch); the extreme-ratio rows (0.49, 0.68, 0.71, 1.24) are expected here if anywhere - 0.49 smells like a missing halving step, 1.24 like a missing boost/screen on the engine side
CAND_unresolved_magnitude.H-C_echo: a minority are echoes of the in-flight mechanisms on adjacent boundaries (Z13.5 precedent: any |cant| boundary drops the residual block); expected mainly for the two component-class rows (psn magnitude, liquidooze mismatch), which sit in residual-block pricing territory, not roll territory
CAND_unresolved_magnitude.expected_split: majority H-A or H-B by legality membership - the replay decides per row; component-class rows H-C or new WHAT

CAND_same_turn_stat_event_gap.H-D1_matcher_limited: the same-turn boost/status event moves the realized damage base between pre-state and the hit; the ENGINE's in-branch value is consistent with the event (engine right), but the matcher's legal set is computed from the PRE-state and cannot confirm, and the window rejects a legitimate roll; lane = instrument/limit, clears in place under an event-aware legality recomputation
CAND_same_turn_stat_event_gap.H-D2_engine_phase: the engine prices the second mover's damage from PRE-event stats (boost/status not applied inside the branch before the dependent damage), so its value is systematically high vs observed (ratio band 0.70-0.96 = observed lower); lane = engine; the ratio direction predicts the event lowers the realized damage (attacker burned/stat-dropped or defender boosted same turn)
CAND_same_turn_stat_event_gap.expected_split: band-consistency argues one mechanism, not a mixture; direction of every sampled ratio (<1) should match the event's sign if H-D2

verdict_rules_registered.membership_test: per sampled row, enumerate the engine's own legal roll set from poke_engine.calculate_damage on every retained candidate state with the recorded joint action; observed IN set => the divergence is the matcher's acceptance path, not the engine's number (instrument/limit lane); observed OUT of set => engine-lane candidate, and the specific pipeline step must be named from the branch instructions before any engine WHY is claimed
verdict_rules_registered.generalization: no shape-level WHY is claimed unless every sampled row in the shape is consistent with it; otherwise the shape is split into sub-shapes or left WHAT-level (candidate-not-finding licensed)
verdict_rules_registered.clearance_prediction: required per shape with signature type: magnitude (clears in place) vs structural (scatters)
verdict_rules_registered.mass_claims: any probability/mass statement uses the engine's own branch enumeration, not narration
